## Design

- `.qa/design/aiberto-companion.md` (Release C1)
- Epic: `.qa/acceptance/aiberto-companion.md` § Release C1
- Depends on AIB-04 (#1127) + AIB-05 (#1128) — both MERGED on `main`

## Intent

Static Read/Nav tool registry + Host dispatcher over public ports and Policy. Character reads via Owned-Ports only. Navigate as ClientAction allowlist. Tool-Activity UI. Flag-gated. No writes, no second AI provider stack, no Atlas workbench edits.

## Preconditions

- AIB-04 `aiberto-ask` + text inference on `main`
- AIB-05 chat UI on `main`
- `PolicyService` has **no** `character.read` op → do not invent one (unknown op = DENY)

## Adaptive surface

- Mode: Overlay (Companion) — Tool-Activity cards inside chat/tools surface
- Gates: **AU-02** (≥44px controls), **AU-08** (aria names), **AU-09** (denied/unknown/budget states), **AU-10** (tokens)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Static registry exposes start catalog: `rulebook.search` / `rulebook.get_section`, `character.list` / `character.get`, `inventory.list`, `world.get`, `session.get_state`, `app.navigate`
- [ ] `TOOL_UNKNOWN` / `INVALID_ARGS` returned before any domain use-case
- [ ] Cross-owner character get DENY via Owned-Ports (SCN-012)
- [ ] Navigate only allowlisted routes as ClientAction
- [ ] Tool-Activity cards render tool name + status (ok/deny/error)
- [ ] `AIBERTO_TOOLS_READ_ENABLED` / `VITE_AIBERTO_TOOLS_READ_ENABLED` default off
- [ ] Capabilities endpoint lists tools but is not an authorization grant
- [ ] Security findings listed for all severities (Critical→Info)
- [ ] Self-test wired; avoid overlapping open-PR files where possible

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Flag off → invoke/capabilities fail-closed (disabled)
- [ ] Forged client `role` / `ownerUserId` ignored — DENY or Owned-Port miss
- [ ] Budget exceeded → rate/budget error, no port call
- [ ] Unknown PolicyOp strings never used as fake allow

## Regression

- [ ] No second provider architecture; reuse `modules/ai` + existing ports
- [ ] No Atlas workbench / `WorldAtlasWorkbench` edits
- [ ] Avoid conflict files while open: Atlas #1283 (`src/domains/world/atlas/index.ts`), AIB-03 #1287 (`e2e/aiberto-phase-a.spec.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`) — `test-gate.mjs` only append AIB-06 after AIB-05 cluster
- [ ] Media `AiModality` catalog unchanged
- [ ] AIB-07/08 not started

## Security Coverage

- B-auth: Actor from Host session only
- B-policy: `aiberto.tools` authenticated gate; `world.read` for world.get; character via Owned-Ports (no invented `character.read`)
- B-injection: tool args schema-validated; DTO filter strips elevated fields
- B-secrets: no provider keys / raw SQL in tool results
- F-xss: Tool-Activity labels are static DE strings + escaped tool ids
- SC-01/02/03/06: auth on routes, no elevated origin from client, budgets, no secret leak
- Out of scope: write tools (AIB-07), MCP (AIB-08)

## Assumptions

- C1 does not require model-native tool calling in `aiberto-ask` stream (Q-005); registry + invoke + UI are the product surface
- `session.get_state` uses membership-checked snapshot + server-derived gm/player projection (never client role)
- `inventory.list` = owned character inventory via `getOwnedInventory`

## Implementation Notes

- Host: `server/src/application/aiberto-tools/**` — static registry, dispatcher, navigate allowlist, budgets
- Policy: `aiberto.tools` (authenticated gate); character via Owned-Ports only; `world.read` for world.get
- HTTP: `GET /api/v1/ai/aiberto-tools/capabilities`, `POST /api/v1/ai/aiberto-tools/invoke` (flag `AIBERTO_TOOLS_READ_ENABLED` default off)
- FE: `aiberto-tools-service`, `AibertoToolActivityCard`, chat tools surface when `VITE_AIBERTO_TOOLS_READ_ENABLED`
- Self-test: `scripts/aiberto-aib-06-tools-read.self-test.mjs` wired after AIB-05 in `test-gate.mjs`
- Security: see PR body findings table (Critical→Info)
